SELECT
FROM eval_subject s
LEFT JOIN sys_subject_type st ON s.subject_type_id = st.type_id AND st.deleted = 0
LEFT JOIN sys_status ss ON s.status_id = ss.status_id AND ss.deleted = 0
LEFT JOIN sys_user cu ON s.contact_id = cu.user_id AND cu.deleted = 0
LEFT JOIN sys_user cre ON s.create_by = cre.user_id AND cre.deleted = 0 WHERE s.deleted = 0 ORDER BY s.id DESC

SELECT
FROM eval_subject s LEFT JOIN sys_subject_type st ON s.subject_type_id = st.type_id AND st.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_status ss ON s.status_id = ss.status_id AND ss.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_user cu ON s.contact_id = cu.user_id AND cu.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_user cre ON s.create_by = cre.user_id AND cre.deleted = 0 WHERE s.subject_id = #{subjectId} AND s.deleted = 0 LIMIT 1

SELECT su.user_id AS user_id, su.user_name AS user_name, su.user_phone AS user_phone, sm.join_time AS join_time FROM eval_subject_member sm LEFT JOIN sys_user su ON sm.user_id = su.user_id AND su.deleted = 0 WHERE sm.subject_id = #{subjectId} AND sm.deleted = 0 AND sm.status_id = (SELECT status_id FROM sys_status WHERE code = 'ENABLED' AND deleted = 0) -- 仅查询启用状态成员

SELECT -- 总主体数 COUNT(s.id) AS total_count, -- 人工主体数（假设sys_subject_type中人工主体编码为'MANUAL'） SUM(CASE WHEN st.code = 'MANUAL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS manual_subject_count, -- 系统主体数（假设编码为'SYSTEM'） SUM(CASE WHEN st.code = 'SYSTEM' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS system_subject_count, -- 启用状态主体数（假设sys_status中启用编码为'ENABLED'） SUM(CASE WHEN ss.code = 'ENABLED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS enabled_count FROM eval_subject s LEFT JOIN sys_subject_type st ON s.subject_type_id = st.type_id AND st.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_status ss ON s.status_id = ss.status_id AND ss.deleted = 0 WHERE s.deleted = 0
